subject: Launching Consulting Alliance: Joint Onboarding & Enablement Pilot
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@consultedge.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: chris.nguyen@consultedge.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Joint pilot idea — consulting alliance onboarding pilot

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the call earlier. ConsultEdge is excited about a lightweight pilot to surface how our SI teams can deliver Redwood-based integrations for three of our mutual customers in Q1. We sketched a short scope (attached) that lays out a 4-week enablement + co-delivery model:

- Week 0: sandbox provisioning + access checklist (security items accounted for)
- Week 1: solution walkthrough + template build (Redwood SDKs + example prompts)
- Week 2: enablement workshops for delivery teams (hands-on labs)
- Week 3: joint go/no-go review + customer handoff

High-level asks from our side: a dedicated enablement liaison, a validation environment for two non-prod model variants, and a short mutual action plan we can keep to track owners. Attached is a draft MVP playbook and a mutual_action_plan spreadsheet.

Can you confirm if Redwood can commit an enablement lead for a 4-week window and whether your security team needs any pre-provisioning docs from us? Also, are your billing/legal contacts needed before we formalize the pilot statement of work?

Best,
Maria Lopez
Head of Alliances, ConsultEdge
---
Attachment: ConsultEdge_SI_Onboard_MVP.pdf (1 page summary)
Attachment: mutual_action_plan_consultedge.xlsx (MVP task owners)

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@consultedge.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Joint pilot idea — consulting alliance onboarding pilot

Maria —

Appreciate the clear draft, and thanks for sending the attachment. This looks doable and aligned with how we typically run SI enablement pilots. Quick answers up front:

- We can assign an enablement liaison (Vanessa Ortiz) to own week-over-week coordination.
- We can provide a validation environment for two non-prod model variants; Naomi will validate the provisioning checklist and confirm network/IP allowlists.
- For billing/legal: we don’t need legal sign-off for the initial enablement pilot if this is a non-billable discovery period — but if ConsultEdge expects Redwood to provide dedicated capacity beyond trial limits, we should loop Legal.

Next steps I propose:
1) Vanessa and I will sync internally Monday to map owners to the mutual action plan.
2) Naomi will review the security checklist and request any missing docs from ConsultEdge.
3) Maria — can you propose two 60-minute working sessions next week for the technical kickoff? TZ: PST works best for our engineering leads.

I’ll add a short internal note summarizing commitments and follow up with an updated mutual_action_plan file by EOD Monday.

Thanks — excited to partner on this.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: ConsultEdge pilot — owners & immediate asks

Team — quick internal thread to line up owners for the ConsultEdge enablement pilot. Summary from the external doc (attached in thread): 4-week enablement + co-delivery pilot. Action items:

- Vanessa: enablement liaison / weekly sync owner. Lead the kickoff sessions and own trainer materials.
- Naomi: security & provisioning verification. Confirm whether we need an IP allowlist, SCIM, or temporary service accounts; outline any SLA constraints for validation env.
- Sean: ops contact for validation environment capacity — we may need 2x non-prod slots and a short burst window during lab week.

Timeline: kickoff sessions next week (Mon/Tue or Wed morning PST). Vanessa to propose 2x slots by EOD and I will reply with preferred times. Naomi please post a short list of any expected evidence ConsultEdge must provide (SOC 2 CSV, subprocessor list, or network diagrams).

Note: keep the pilot non-billable unless ConsultEdge asks for reserved Dedicated capacity; escalate to Legal and Sales Ops if scope changes.

Thanks — brief replies suffice, we want to move fast.

—Monica

From: Chris Nguyen <chris.nguyen@consultedge.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@consultedge.com>, legal@consultedge.com
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Joint pilot idea — consulting alliance onboarding pilot

Monica / Vanessa / Naomi —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for lining up owners. We’re happy to keep the initial pilot non-billable. For the kickoff, we can do either:

- Tue 22 Dec 10:00–11:00 PST (tech kickoff) or
- Wed 23 Dec 09:00–10:00 PST (tech kickoff)

Attached is a short security packet and our SOC 2 summary; please confirm whether that addresses Naomi’s checklist. We’ll also populate the mutual_action_plan spreadsheet with our owners and tentative dates.

If anything pops that could trigger billing (e.g., dedicated capacity requests), we’ll flag that and loop legal. Otherwise we’ll treat this as discovery/enablement.

Best,
Chris Nguyen
Director, Strategic Partnerships, ConsultEdge
